sloka: द्रुमवर्षं तु तच्छिन्नं दृष्ट्वा कुम्भेन वीर्यवान्।वानराधिपतिः श्रीमान् महासत्त्वो न विव्यथे ।। ६.७६.६९ ।।
transliteration: drumavarṣaṁ tu tacchinnaṁ dṛṣṭvā kumbhena vīryavān।vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmān mahāsattvo na vivyathe ।। 6.76.69 ।।

translations.english: Valiant hero, the prosperous and noble Sugriva, the chief of Vanaras did not get distressed when tormented with rain of trees.
